title.narrative: UNICEF strengthened prevention and response systems against violence toward children, reaching over 120,000 individuals with positive parenting tools, training, and campaigns. Key advancements include piloting of a national parenting program, launching community violence prevention program, enhancing multisectoral response services, and developing strategies to address armed violence impacts and child recruitment.
